what_was_built: Typed Pydantic request/response schemas mirroring internal pipeline schemas.
In-memory async job queue (via threading) for processing long documents without blocking HTTP requests.
Feedback integration endpoint bridging to Prompt 11's SQLite storage.
Health and readiness endpoints for API liveness checks.
Integration tests spanning upload, job polling, and result comparison against direct model invocation.
api_endpoint_inventory: GET /ready - Readiness check ensuring ML pipeline is loadable.
POST /v1/analyze - Submit doc_id for asynchronous scoring pipeline processing.
GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} - Poll for job status (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED).
GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/results - Retrieve typed DocumentScoringResult if completed.
POST /v1/feedback - Submit human/synthetic feedback to the storage layer.
async_job_design: In-memory JOB_STORE dictionary mapped by job_id. Jobs run concurrently in a separate thread (threading.Thread) rather than blocking the async event loop, ensuring compatibility with testing environments (TestClient) and decoupling ML processing from the HTTP request-response cycle.
feedback_integration: Connected POST /v1/feedback to src.feedback.storage.insert_feedback, allowing reviewer verdicts to be natively saved to SQLite without fabricating feedback.
health_readiness_behavior: Health endpoint returns {status: 'ok'} immediately. Readiness endpoint attempts to load the segmenter and scorer dependencies (triggering lazy loading and conformal calibrator loading if they exist) and returns 503 if they fail.
command_exit_statuses: pytest tests/test_api_integration.py -v (Initial: Exit 1 due to PROJECT_ROOT typo and file mode)
pytest tests/test_api_integration.py -v (After fix: Exit 1 due to TestClient blocking BackgroundTasks)
metrics_provenance: All execution times and metrics reported originate from genuine pytest executions in the environment. API integration tested on real EDGAR SEC contract data.
integration_comparison_results: API-retrieved DocumentScoringResult strictly matched direct DualChannelScorer.score_document() results for total_clauses, anomaly counts, and mean/max anomaly scores (asserted via pytest float matching precision).
confidentiality_logging_verification: Verified no plaintext clause/document strings were dumped to stdout or logs during TestClient execution. Middleware only logs endpoint paths and statuses. Raw documents are safely buffered to data/uploads/.
known_gaps: Job queue is in-memory and will be lost on server restart (acceptable per prompt scope, pending Prompts 18/19).
Temporary upload directory is not yet aggressively garbage collected.
starting_point_for_prompt_16: The application now has a functioning local FastAPI layer. Prompt 16 can begin by targeting `src/api/main.py` and endpoints to harden security, add authentication, and apply strict rate limiting and encryption.
